issuer: the Government of the Northwest Territories, Department of Infrastructure, Driver and Vehicle Services
note: The Department of Infrastructure's Driver and Vehicle Services pages (read 2026-10-30): a learner's licence (Class 7) from 15, held at least one year; then a probationary Class 5P, which needs the driver to be at least 16, held 12 months suspension-free before the upgrade to a full Class 5: a full licence is kept from 17 (15, plus one year and 12 months). A new 5-year licence costs $110 (3 years $84, 1 year $46; seniors less). The General Identification Card is issued from 12, valid for five years (to a work permit's end for foreign nationals who aren't permanent residents), at $54 new. The foreign nationals page says another province's licence may be transferred and some countries' licences may be, without naming them or saying no test is sat, so no exchange list is held.

sources.title: GNWT Driver and Vehicle Services, Get a driver's licence for the first time
sources.said: Be 15 years of age or older ... Must hold a Learner’s licence (Class 7) for at least one year ... Must hold a Class 5P or 6P licence for 12 months suspension-free to be eligible to upgrade to Class 5 or 6. ... must be at least 16-years-old. ... 5-year new licence: $110

sources.title: GNWT Driver and Vehicle Services, Get an identification card for the first time
sources.said: General identification cards (GIC) are valid for five years ... Clients that are 12 years of age or older are eligible to obtain a GIC. ... New card: $54
